desc: The all-new Simmons Pro Hunter Binoculars are built with an all-glass optical system providing crisp images in low lighting conditions with fully coated lenses and IPX7 waterproof and fog-proof construction giving you peace of mind in the outdoors. An aggressive rugged design with textured grip zones keep these binoculars securely in your hands. The Pro Hunter binoculars also feature a tripod adapter lug and include a convenient soft-sided carry case, neoprene neck strap, rubber lens covers and lens cleaning cloth.
